agreement_note: Agreement with the CPU uses objective, plant output and steam-side quantities. Water-side pressure, return-side temperature and flow in lightly loaded pipes are not unique at the optimum (docs/validation-notes.md) and are reported separately under nonunique_* fields.

environment.other_processes_note: gpu_other_processes counts other compute processes seen on this GPU during each run.

label: All networks and demand profiles are synthetic and describe no real campus.

not_run.reason: Attempted once locally and neither solver finished; see results/logs/benchmarks_year_attempt.txt.
Added from calibration.json when the parts of a site build are merged; this file was not merged.

notes: Synthetic data. Each point is the median over the repeats that met a tolerance of 1.0e-8, from the local sweep. A hollow point marks a size where a repeat did not solve, or where the GPU reported success but its largest residual was more than 2 times the CPU's.

solver_settings.achieved_tolerance_matched: True when the GPU's largest KKT residual over the solved repeats, recomputed on the unscaled model, is at most 2.0 times the CPU's.
solver_settings.cpu_ipopt_mumps: Ipopt with MUMPS on the same ExaModel, tol = 1e-8
solver_settings.cpu_madnlp_mumps: MadNLP defaults with MUMPS, one BLAS thread
solver_settings.gpu_madnlp_cudss: MadNLP GPU defaults (condensed KKT, cuDSS LDL), richardson_max_iter = 30, richardson_tol = 1e-12, synchronous cuDSS so that linear solver time is reported
solver_settings.gpu_madnlp_cudss_async: As gpu_madnlp_cudss with asynchronous cuDSS, the package default; MadNLP does not report linear solver time in this mode
solver_settings.strict_mode: Acceptable termination is off, so SOLVE_SUCCEEDED means the requested tolerance was met. bound_relax_factor = 1e-8 on CPU and GPU.
